facts.claim: Very good cows are reared in Bangalore and sell for between 40 and 80 rupees each.
facts.quote: Very good cows are reared in Bangalore, where they sell for from Re. 40 to 80 a piece.

facts.claim: These cows are fed green fodder, ragi straw and husks of avare and can yield three to five quarts of milk per day when fully milking.
facts.quote: They are fed on green fodder, ragi straw and the husks of avare, and should yield from 3 to 5 quarts a day when in full milk.

facts.claim: The quality of mutton sold in Bangalore has been greatly improved by municipal prizes at the new market.
facts.quote: The quality of the mutton sold in Bangalore has been greatly improved by means of prizes offered by the Municipality at the new market.
